outcome: Death in hospital within 28 days of ICU admission: patient.hospitaldischargestatus == 'Expired' AND hospitaldischargeoffset <= 40320 min (offsets are from ICU admission). eICU has no post-discharge death date, so deaths after hospital discharge are not captured (limitation).
predictors: built from eICU first 24 h exactly as Notebook 2 (vitals 0-24 h, labs -6 to +24 h, same cleaning ranges, same TPIFE thresholds/carry-forward caps); predictors not used by the model are not built
missing_data: frozen MIMIC preparation object (prep_<arm>.joblib): clip to MIMIC training limits, frozen MICE imputation; NOTHING is refitted on eICU
metrics: calibration intercept and slope (logistic), E/O ratio, ICI, LOESS calibration plot
locked threshold (0.421 random / 0.368 temporal): sensitivity, specificity, PPV, NPV (bootstrap CI)
locked risk tiers (22.9% / 49.1%): observed mortality per tier with Wilson CI
Venn-Abers uncertainty: share of patients whose interval crosses a tier cut-off
decision curve: net benefit at 30% vs treat-all
comparators: SOFA and APACHE II (rebuilt from eICU first-24-h data with the frozen MIMIC logistic models), DeLong
eICU's own APACHE IVa predicted hospital mortality (apachePatientResult), discrimination only, as a reference
updating: Secondary only: logistic recalibration (intercept and slope) reported as an UPDATED model; the primary result is always the frozen, unchanged model
sensitivity: complete-case: patients with all 25 predictors measured
hospital-cluster bootstrap CI for AUROC (64 hospitals)
rules: The outcome is read once, in the evaluation cell, after predictors and predictions are saved
No model, threshold, tier or preprocessing change after the outcome is read
All results are reported whatever they show
